name: smart-darshan
description: Smart Darshan - real-time queue and crowd management for temples (MERN + Python ML)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && python -m pip install -r ml-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,api,ml,web -c gray,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:web"
